meta.disclaimer: Deadlines, thresholds and penalties are indicative based on commonly applicable Indian statutes and notifications as of lastVerified. Always re-verify against the official government portal and latest gazette before acting. ComplianceEasily uses this dataset to map and remind — it is not a substitute for professional legal advice.

triggerTypes.label: Date Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Statutory calendar deadline
triggerTypes.description: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annual calendar dues such as GSTR-3B, TDS returns, AOC-4 and advance tax.

triggerTypes.label: Turnover Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Revenue threshold breaches
triggerTypes.description: Crossing GST, e-invoicing, tax audit or TReDS thresholds based on aggregate turnover.

triggerTypes.label: Employee Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Headcount thresholds
triggerTypes.description: Hiring thresholds that activate PT deduction, POSH, Gratuity, EPFO or ESIC obligations.

triggerTypes.label: Location Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Geographic expansion
triggerTypes.description: New branch, warehouse or storefront requiring APOB, trade licence or state PT.

triggerTypes.label: Industry Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: New business activities
triggerTypes.description: Activity-based licences such as FSSAI, IEC, Factory licence or Pollution consent.

triggerTypes.label: Director / Partner Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Corporate governance events
triggerTypes.description: Director appointment/resignation, DIN KYC, share transfer or capital increase.

triggerTypes.label: Licence Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Approaching expirations
triggerTypes.description: Renewal alerts before FSSAI, Shops & Establishment, Factory, Fire NOC or CTO lapse.

triggerTypes.label: Notice Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Departmental communications
triggerTypes.description: GST discrepancy notices, Income Tax intimations or EPFO verification letters.

triggerTypes.label: Law Change Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Regulatory amendments
triggerTypes.description: New MCA forms, Union Budget TDS changes or state labour code notifications.

triggerTypes.label: Transaction Trigger
triggerTypes.subtitle: Capital & bank activities
triggerTypes.description: Equity rounds, charge registration on loans or acquisition of immovable property.
